title: A learning
description: One record in learnings/<id>.json. Controlled values are listed in schema/vocabulary.json; sources in sources/sources.json. scripts/check.py enforces this.

id.description: the title as a GitHub anchor (lower case, punctuation dropped, spaces to hyphens); also the file name

statement.description: the learning, one plain sentence; no people's names or roles

example.description: optional: one sentence with the number that shows it

facets.description: keys of vocabulary.facets, the main one first

stage.description: a key of vocabulary.stages; required when role is method, null otherwise

scope.description: universal (holds for any lesson) or domain (holds where its domains say)

domains.description: where the evidence came from: keys of vocabulary.domains

detail.description: markdown: where it came from and what the record shows; cite paths in backticks with their source prefix

against.description: markdown: counter-evidence and limits, or "none found"

verified.description: script, agent or manual: how the quote was checked

commit.description: a commit whose message holds the quote; path is then the repository's folder

at.description: a revision: the quote is in the file as it was there (for a file deleted later)

member.description: a file inside the archive at path, where the quote is

updated.description: YYYY-MM-DD, when changed after it was added
